meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 你做完或改动界面后,Claude 会截屏或抓终端画面,对参考图做像素对比,再派两个独立检查员核查设计风格、功能和中/日/韩文截断,最后给出“好/不行”结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或修改任何网页、组件或终端界面后,或当你问界面看起来是否正常时;也可在你提到“视觉 QA”“截图/像素对比”“UI 不对劲”时触发。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,帮我做一次视觉 QA。
say.note: Claude 会截图并检查设计一致性和文字截断。

say.text: 把这个页面跟设计稿截图对比,告诉我哪里不一样。
say.note: 它会跑像素差异并给出问题清单。

say.text: 检查这个命令行工具的表格边框有没有对齐。
say.note: 它会抓取终端画面并检查对齐和溢出。

howto.what_en: After you build or change any UI, Claude captures screenshots or TUI captures, diffs them against references, runs two read-only reviewer passes (design-system/functional and visual/CJK), then gives a clear good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any web/TUI interface, when asked whether a page or component looks right, or when mentioning visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, or UI looks wrong.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page — run a visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Claude captures and checks design consistency and clipping.

say_en.text: Compare this page to the design mockup and tell me what differs.
say_en.note: It produces a pixel diff and lists the issues.

say_en.text: Check whether the table borders in this CLI tool are aligned.
say_en.note: It captures the terminal and checks alignment and overflow.
